cards.title: Residual Error and Mixture Model for Inoculum Variability
cards.claim: To handle replicate variability and inoculum heterogeneity, the residual error was divided into a consistent difference between replicates and a replicate-specific difference. A mixture model was used to allocate experiments to two classes: those starting in logarithmic growth phase (all susceptible) and those approaching stationary phase (mixed susceptible/resting).
conditions: Variability in starting inoculum growth phase
limitations: Assumption that inoculum variability is the primary source of between-experiment variation
cards.downstream_use: Improved model fit and parameter precision by accounting for experimental noise and biological variability in starting conditions.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
